COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Committee of the Whole was held on Wednesday, June 7, 2023, in Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 6:02 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: President Richard Johnson, Chairman; Dr. Michelle Aldrich (via
Zoom), Bryan Cook, Ken Esquibel, Pete Laybourn (via Zoom), Dr. Mark Rinne (via Zoom), Scott
Roybal, Tom Segrave and Jeff White.

AGENDA ITEMS

7. ORDINANCE ~3" READING ~ Ordinance appropriating moneys for the City of
Cheyenne, Wyoming for the various purposes in conducting the municipal government of
said City and fixing the amount of general and special taxes as part of the revenue required
to meet the said appropriation, all for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2023 and ending
June 30, 2024.

Mr. Cook joined the meeting at 6:08 p.m.

Mr. Roybal moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Main motion,
as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Dr. Rinne moved to amend to decrease the Miscellaneous Department “Transfer to Reserves” line
item by $5,000 and increase the Professional Development line item in the City Council
Department by the same amount, seconded by Mr. Roybal. Motion to amend carried by unanimous
voice vote.

Dr. Rinne moved to amend to decrease the Miscellaneous Department “Transfer to Reserves” line
item by $75,618.00 and increase various payroll expenditure line items in the Community
Recreation and Events Department, Botanic Gardens Division, by the same amount to decrease
the Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund Botanic Gardens Operations and Maintenance account
payroll line items by $75,618.00 and decrease the Specific Purpose Option Tax revenue by the
same amount, seconded by Mr. Cook. Motion to amend carried by unanimous voice vote.

Mayor Patrick Collins briefly reviewed the amendments previously made to the budget on 2"!
reading and noted the budget is on track to be finalized at the meeting of the governing body on
June 12, 2023. Dr. Rinne provided information related to the request for additional professional
development funds in the City Council budget. Robin Lockman, City Treasurer, provided
additional information and Chairman Johnson and committee members Aldrich and Esquibel
commented on the amendment, Dr. Rinne provided information on the amendment to transfer the
Botanic Gardens event coordinator position back to the general fund and committee members
Aldrich and Cook commented on the amendment.
